- Spring roll (about 100 g, ~130 kcal) and 2 sushi pieces (about 60 g, ~90 kcal) on the first plate.
- Tofu with slaw salad: about 150 g, ~200 kcal.
- Fruit bowl: about 150 g, ~60 kcal.
- Ham and cheese sandwich: about 280 g, ~600 kcal for a sub roll with ham, cheese and lettuce.

Adding the food items gives 130 + 90 + 200 + 60 + 600 = 1080 kcal. Mass is 100 + 60 + 150 + 150 + 280 = 740 g.
